title: Capricornia Cays National Park
get_in:
The only way to get in the national park is via charter boat or by plane, with one of [https://parks.des.qld.gov.au/parks/capricornia-cays/about#tourism_information_links these] following operators. Most boats depart from [[Gladstone (Queensland)|Gladstone]], [[Bundaberg]], or [[1770]].

Heron Island has [https://www.heronisland.com/stay/getting-here regular ferries] from Gladstone that departs at {{time|9:30AM}} every morning except on Tuesdays and Thursdays which returns back to Gladstone at {{time|12:30PM}}.
